Thomas Cook India, SOTC curate year-end holidays across domestic and international destinations
Thomas Cook India and SOTC Travel have introduced a portfolio of year-end holidays combining New Year celebrations with immersive destination experiences. The offerings cover Australia, New Zealand, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, India and the Arctic, alongside ocean and expedition cruises, through air-inclusive group tours and customised itineraries for Indian travellers.
